question: Does the app report denied, missing and busy camera states clearly, release resources, and recover on retry?

cases.name: denied
cases.intent: The user or the OS refuses camera access.
cases.failureStatus: Camera permission denied. Allow camera access for this local app, then retry.

cases.name: missing
cases.failureStatus: No camera found. Connect a webcam, then press Start camera.

cases.name: busy
cases.failureStatus: Camera is busy. Close the other camera app, then retry.

cases.name: overconstrained
cases.intent: The device cannot satisfy the requested resolution.
cases.failureStatus: This camera cannot provide the selected resolution. Choose another resolution, then retry.

limits: Injected DOMExceptions, not a physical device: the browser permission UI and OS camera privacy setting are untouched.
Recovery is verified against the fake device, so it shows the application path recovers, not that a real camera re-acquires.
One attempt per state on one host; no repeated-failure or flapping-device behaviour is covered.
